channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: WATCH: Powerful home explosion rocks Ohio community, shaking felt at least two miles away
item.description: A powerful home explosion in Canton, Ohio, damaged nearby homes and injured two people seriously.

item.title: New Jersey officer disguised as shrub catches distracted drivers on video
item.description: A New Jersey police department has adopted a new approach to catch drivers suspected of distraction.

item.title: Outgoing Ukrainian ambassador reflects on evolving Kyiv-Washington ties
item.description: Ukraine's outgoing ambassador to the U.S. says the country has countered what she called a previous, inaccurate narrative about Russia.

item.title: Analysis: As diplomacy fails, US-Iran conflict expands
item.description: The 14-point agreement with Iran signed by President Trump in mid-June was meant to be a diplomatic exit.
